name: feature_native_layout

ownership.argument: Lifecycle callbacks receive native FeaturePrototype/FeatureInstance pointers, not JSValue objects. onCreate(ctx,proto), onRequired(ctx,instance), onDestroy(ctx,proto). onCreate precedes assignment of prototype JSValue; onRequired sees initialized instance JSValue. Async initialized/closed only on owner loop; retain independent pipe file for cross-task-group wake.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.036 AP producer/consumer and data-layout review; see p67-036-native-contract.md.

notes: Corrects previous inference that lifecycle callbacks receive JS objects requiring JS_GetOpaque. Runtime Feature class id0x2013CE38 is only needed when unwrapping a JS object through stock JS stubs.
